QUIC client code to send one or more transaction payloads to a target address and port.

# Purpose
This file defines the `txn` action for an `fddev` command set. It parses command-line options, checks permissions, and sends one or more transaction payloads to a target QUIC endpoint. The action accepts an optional Base64-encoded payload, a transaction count, and optional destination IP and port. If no payload is given, it uses the embedded `sample_transaction` binary data.

The main work is done in [`txn_cmd_fn`](<#txn_cmd_fn>) and [`send_quic_transactions`](<#send_quic_transactions>). The code enters a network namespace when required, waits for the validator to be ready by calling `ready_cmd_fn`, creates and configures a QUIC client, and then opens streams to send each transaction. It uses QUIC callbacks to track handshake completion, connection final state, and stream notifications. The file ends by exporting the action in `fd_action_txn`, which makes `txn` available as an external command interface.
